summary: Iteration 17 — Resend email module (transactional + interaction + admin internal). 22/22 backend tests PASS and all 4 frontend flows PASS. Real emails delivered via Resend (resend_id present in email_log). Full backend regression: 12 pre-existing failures unrelated to iteration 17 (chat noise leftovers, geo, notification counts) — no new regressions introduced.

minor.issue: Returns 200 with {ok:false} on invalid token (documented behavior for List-Unsubscribe). Not a bug, just noting.

action_items: Pre-existing regressions (not iteration 17 scope): test_iteration11 chat noise leftover 't0-*' group messages need cleanup; test_iteration4 rate-limit + unread counts; test_iteration8 geo-comuna backfill; test_iteration9 onboarding_birthdate_gate (3 failures). These pre-date iteration 17 and are due to shared demo-data pollution across test runs. Recommend adding per-test cleanup for group_messages and matches.
critical_code_review_comments: email_service.py line 190: `_sent_today_interaction_count` filters by `sent_at >= today_start` but pending/queued rows without sent_at will be skipped. OK because status filter includes 'queued'.

server.py line 541: event_ref for password_reset uses timestamp — so two rapid forgot-password requests create two distinct email_log rows. This is acceptable (idempotency_key still unique) but doesn't fully implement 'no new email on duplicate within short window'. Consider bucketing to 5-minute windows.

email_service.py `send_email` gates order: quiet_hours check happens before daily_cap. On queued item, daily_cap is never checked when eventually drained (drain_queue skips gates). Acceptable trade-off but worth documenting.
PasswordFlows.jsx line 79: reset submit is disabled when !token but does NOT show a friendly 'link inválido' message — user just sees a disabled button silently.
seed_data_creation: None. Tests use existing demo1/demo2 users and clean their like/match/email_log state before each flow. Google-only variant creates+deletes a throwaway user.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter17 test file is at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration17_emails.py. It loads /app/backend/.env for JWT_SECRET so forged reset/unsub tokens match server. Real Resend emails are sent — do not spam retries. Pre-existing failures in iterations 4/8/9/11 are due to test-data pollution and are outside iter17 scope.
